caveats: 94 notices and every split of it is smaller. The paired control is 21 animal notices; the breadth result's widest band is 14.
No closure date in the animal table, so lead time is not computable without parsing 94 letter PDFs. The human side runs 177-181 days.
Refiling chains are matched on normalised substance names, so a refiling under a renamed substance is missed and the 31% comeback rate is a floor.
Purpose and species categories are ours, read off each notice's stated use and intended species. A quarter of recent notices have no stated use because FDA declined to evaluate it.
The recipe's previous headline, 'animal feed innovation is mostly about wasting less', was a claim about 2010-14: efficiency runs 72, 53, 21 and 10 per cent by era.
Repeat filers clear more, but a firm that files four times is a firm that had four ingredients worth filing. Learning and selection cannot be separated here.
